capabilities: Intercept image paste and drag-drop events and insert links
Upload images to Cloudflare R2 as Markdown URLs
Compress images to WebP and strip EXIF metadata before upload
Save images to the vault's attachment folder as wikilinks
Batch upload existing local images across the vault or a folder
extras: The manifest description mentions R2/S3 upload, but the README roadmap lists AWS S3 and other providers as planned rather than shipped; paste/drop interception only activates when R2 credentials are configured. Installation via BRAT is documented and the author offers WeChat-based support.
problem: Pasted images clutter the vault with binary files or use local paths that break when notes move between machines.

relations.evidence: Automatic WebP Compression — Powered by browser-image-compression.

requires.name: R2 API token with Object Read & Write permission

summary: Image paste and drag-drop handler that uploads pictures to Cloudflare R2 or saves them locally, inserting a Markdown link or wikilink.
